name: featured-card
description: A two-column featured content card with optional image, WYSIWYG body, primary and secondary CTA buttons, and a photo credit / author avatar block. Migrated from the Squiz 'NTGDS - Featured content (landing page only)' Content Container Template.

body.title: Body content
body.description: Rich text / WYSIWYG content rendered inside the featured card.

imagePosition.title: Image position
imagePosition.description: Side the image column appears on. Defaults to right.

background.title: Background colour
background.description: Background colour variant. 'white' also applies a box shadow.

border.title: Border
border.description: Whether to draw a border around the card.

imageSrc.title: Image URL
imageSrc.description: Fully-qualified URL of the image to display in the right/left column.

imageAlt.title: Image alt text
imageAlt.description: Accessible description of the image. Required when imageSrc is set.

imageCaption.title: Image caption / photo credit
imageCaption.description: Optional caption rendered beneath the card. Takes priority over authorName.

authorName.title: Author name
authorName.description: Fallback avatar name shown beneath the card when no caption is set.

authorAgency.title: Author agency
authorAgency.description: Agency or organisation displayed below the author name.

primaryActionText.title: Primary button text
primaryActionText.description: Label for the primary CTA button. Leave blank to hide.

primaryActionHref.title: Primary button URL
primaryActionHref.description: URL the primary CTA links to.

primaryActionExternal.title: Primary button opens in new tab
primaryActionExternal.description: When true, opens the primary CTA in a new tab with rel="noopener noreferrer".

secondaryActionText.title: Secondary button text
secondaryActionText.description: Label for the secondary CTA button. Leave blank to hide.

secondaryActionHref.title: Secondary button URL
secondaryActionHref.description: URL the secondary CTA links to.

secondaryActionExternal.title: Secondary button opens in new tab
secondaryActionExternal.description: When true, opens the secondary CTA in a new tab with rel="noopener noreferrer".
